scope: Ukrainian stress, Sanskrit phoneme projections and contextual transliteration; only public mathematical laws and illustrative inputs recorded, not unpublished donor code.

candidates.law: Transfer 1-based positions of U+0301 stress from source vowel nuclei to corresponding target vowel nuclei, recognizing upper/lower case equally; reject invalid or out-of-range marks and a pre-accented target. No rewriting of other characters.
candidates.falsifier: Do not accept combining acute after a consonant or silently lose an out-of-range stress position.
candidates.dedup: D7 already owns the acute-mark symbol. Full D1-D10 behavioral dedup and native oracle required before selection. Distinct from D7 U+0301 code-point identity; review against generic FINITE-MEALY-RUN and list walks before any selection.

donor_snapshot.note: Original upstream authorship not asserted. Donor counts lowercase on extraction and both cases on insertion; proposal intentionally strengthens the behavior and requires native oracle.

candidates.law: An explicit finite rule table selects word-start replacement before default; otherwise longest matching multigraph before shorter graph, then a specified after-consonant rule; preserve unmatched characters and apostrophe word continuity.
candidates.falsifier: A shorter key must not consume the prefix of a longer admissible key.
candidates.dedup: Compare with D10 APPLY-SANDHI and D8 string rewriting; no D2 parser/control semantics is minted. Peer cross-hobby finite-state transducer research in main (knowledge/d10-finite-transducer-cross-hobby-v1.json, #4914) can implement a contextual rewrite; likely a derived/projection family pending expressibility proof, not an independent resident by default.

donor_snapshot.note: README attributes project to upstream paiv/latynka. Only limited lowercase semantics are modeled; full source parity and license verification remain open.

holds: Dictionary-driven stress disambiguation needs language morphology and independent native oracle.
General case/Unicode behavior of third-party transliteration remains outside this scoped law.

related_research.conclusion: Both candidate laws remain HOLD. In particular contextual transliteration may be a parameterization of FINITE-MEALY-RUN rather than a fresh root.

audit_scope: No copy of donor implementations, phonemic tables, or private repository documents. Only source identifiers and research summaries.
